Enter the Friday 11:00 carrier pickup appointment on the shipping board and ensure all 180 stainless enclosures are staged by Friday 10:00.
Freeze campaign sequence as Order K (320 aluminum brackets) followed by Order L (180 stainless enclosures) to minimize material-family setup loss, with 2-hour maintenance window before Order L.
